member.name: M:Iot.Device.Pn532.Pn532.CreateWriteMessage(Iot.Device.Pn532.CommandSet,System.SpanByte)
member.summary: PREAMBLE 1 byte4 START CODE 2 bytes (0x00 and 0xFF), LEN 1 byte indicating the number of bytes in the data field (TFI and PD0 to PDn), LCS 1 Packet Length Checksum LCS byte that satisfies the relation: Lower byte of [LEN + LCS] = 0x00, TFI 1 byte frame identifier, the value of this byte depends on the way of the message - D4h in case of a frame from the host controller to the PN532, - D5h in case of a frame from the PN532 to the host controller. DATA LEN-1 bytes of Packet Data Information The first byte PD0 is the Command Code, DCS 1 Data Checksum DCS byte that satisfies the relation: Lower byte of [TFI + PD0 + PD1 + … + PDn + DCS] = 0x00, POSTAMBLE 1 byte2. The amount of data that can be exchanged using this frame structure is limited to 255 bytes (including TFI). 00 00 FF LEN LCS TFI PD0 PD1 ……... PDn DCS 00 -- ----- --- --- --- ----------------- --- -- | | | | | | | |_ Postamble | | | | | | |____ Packet Data Checksum | | | | | |______________ Packet Data | | | | |___________________________ Specific PN532 Frame Identifier | | | |_______________________________ Packet Length Checksum | | |___________________________________ Packet Length | |________________________________________ Start codes |_____________________________________________ Preamble If the length is large than 255, then you have LEN and LCS = 0xFF and 2 additional bytes for the MBS and LBS size of the real length

member.name: T:Iot.Device.Pn532.RfConfiguration.MaxRetriesMode
member.summary: The parameters MxRtyATR, MxRtyPSL and MxRtyPassiveActivation define the number of retries that the PN532 will use in case of the following processes

member.name: P:Iot.Device.Pn532.RfConfiguration.MaxRetriesMode.MaxRetryAnswerToReset
member.summary: MxRtyATR is a byte containing the number of times that the PN532 will retry to send the ATR_REQ in case of incorrect reception of the ATR_RES(or no reception at all - timeout). For active mode, value 0xFF means to try eternally, 0x00 means only once(no retry, only one try). The default value of this parameter is 0xFF (infinitely). For passive mode, the value is always overruled with 0x02 (two retries).

member.name: P:Iot.Device.Pn532.RfConfiguration.MaxRetriesMode.MaxRetryPSL
member.summary: MxRtyPSL is a byte containing the number of times that: • The PN532 will retry to send the PSL_REQ in case of incorrect reception of the PSL_RES(or no reception at all) for the NFC IP1 protocol, • The PN532 will retry to send the PPS request in case of incorrect reception of the PPS response(or no reception at all) for the ISO/IEC14443-4 protocol. Value 0xFF means to try eternally, 0x00 means only once(no retry, only one try).The default value of this parameter is 0x01 (the PSL_REQ/PPS request is sent twice in case of need).

member.name: P:Iot.Device.Pn532.RfConfiguration.MaxRetriesMode.MaxRetryPassiveActivation
member.summary: MxRtyPassiveActivation is a byte containing the number of times that the PN532 will retry to activate a target in InListPassiveTarget command (§7.3.5, p: 115). Value 0xFF means to try eternally, 0x00 means only once(no retry, only one try). The default value of this parameter is 0xFF (infinitely).

member.name: P:Iot.Device.Pn532.RfConfiguration.VariousTimingsMode.AnsweToRequestResponseTimeout
member.summary: The second byte in this item defines the timeout between ATR_REQ and ATR_RES when the PN532 is in initiator mode.A target is considered as mute if no valid ATR_RES is received within this timeout value. In this way, the PN532 can easily detect non TPE target in passive 212-424 kbps mode. The default value for this parameter is 0x0B (102.4 ms).

member.name: P:Iot.Device.Pn532.RfConfiguration.VariousTimingsMode.RetryTimeout
member.summary: The third byte defines the timeout value that the PN532 uses in the InCommunicateThru(§7.3.9, p: 136) command to give up reception from the target in case of no answer. The default value for this parameter is 0x0A (51.2 ms). This timeout definition is also used with InDataExchange(§7.3.8, p: 127) when the target is a FeliCa or a Mifare card(Ultralight, Standard…).
